article_summaries.title: Free Realms Comic #5 Is On Sale Now!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing that issue #5 of the Free Realms comic book is on sale. The issue reveals a secret from Darkthorne and hints at a possible spy in Queen Valerian's court. Each of the 12 comic issues carries a unique code redeemable for a special in-game item.
